devNotes.content: # Day 1 of "Immersive" Web Design :P *so immersive that it took us back to the days when they made this website..with poor bandwidth* Started the class thinking we'd dive right into coding and the know-hows but it was really nice to start the course with some light presentations and discussions. I really didn't expect there to be actual websites and archives made by people that preserve the graphics and, of course, the websites of the good old days, which was so cool! It was refreshing to see people making things just because they wanted to, and not just for a client. This made me think, we've all gotten so industry-oriented now :((( I honestly didn't think we could have so much fun with websites, and the line "think of web as a space....think of it as a garden" now makes so much more sense. Here's my submission, some of the screenshots that caught my eye.... hoping to see more and making something fun out of this moodboard! Thanks! Byeeeeeee [click here](https://www.figma.com/design/w940kHrJur0unxyKG5MXdd/WEBSITESSS?node-id=0-1&t=vlWmI15yX2UPOPoG-1)

# Day 2 was ugggllllyyy (i'm kidding) *Is this the real life? Is this just fantasy?* You know what? The basics of coding aren't that tough to understand!! I meannn my notes from next week will prove otherwise maybe but with Laurel's video and Sir's presentation, I realized that it wasn't rocket science. It was all in my head. I have to admit, it was a biiitttt tough to pay attention all the time, all the html, < p >, < h >, div, css, vscode did a 360 on my brain. I was questioning the purpose of life and what not.... ok I'm exaggerating now, it wasn't that bad. Then we had the physical website game and that was such a cool exercise! The Tarein Zameen Par song was playing in my head the whole time when we were all cutting up the strips, the one that goes... *tu dhoop hai, cham se bikhar...tu hai nadi, tu hai bekhabar* :P I have enjoyed making the front-end of websites and applications, and now adding that knowledge with the stuff that goes on behind designing, I got curious about the coding. Who came up with such a concept? Ooof.. I play a few games on my phone, and I feel pretty good about it because they're at Level 200 or something, but todays CSS Diner game made me feel so dumb omg, it was harddd to comprehend the examples, but a genuinely needed practice. When it made sense, it felt satisfying, but when it didn't, I wanted to throw my laptop. I think I need to be more patient with learning.... The besssttt thing about today was making the ugly website@#$%^!?/ I love sidetracking from design principles honestly. Searching up the properties and understanding which code does what was excitinggg. My first websiteeee I'm so happy! There were times where it was not working out but nothing that some practice can't solve. I'm really glad for this course because I can now think in another direction for my creative output, after some more knowledge and practice ofcourse, and also just make ugly websites for fun. Because why not? Here's a screenshot of my website, can't wait to see the "rhapsodies" that my classmates have made. I think that's it for today, okayy thanks byiiiieeeee

# JNJEBHJVBEFJNVIUESBVUIDFKJDVFEVFDVFDVFDV *stomped my keyboard as badly as I could* Lost my mind, control, brain cells, the will to live, energy, social battery, appetite, social skills, my **EVERYTHING** I thought the first two levels of space oddity was easy, and how foolish was I to be happy about that because the next levels sucked the life out of me. I never knew frustration at this level, I never so badly wanted to jump off a cliff before today. I'm not able to process any emotions right now so I can't look at the silver lining of today, so please excuse me for that. I just want to crash-out but I'm exhausted to even do that. Yesterday was all "ooh this is so fun i'm so excited I made an ugly website" and todays just snffjkncmsdcdsckjd I think my brain has shut off now, let me pack-up and go home before I get calls from my mom. Some gratitude words I used to write but now too sad to repeat RIP-Me

# Non-ugly day *you just have to fail a little less everyday...that's progress. aaj ka suvichar* I think the rain was today's highlight, also the fact that we took a break from coding...to think about our website that we'll be making!!!! I don't know what it was, either the blog I read that sir posted yesterday..the one with kayaking, or the entire day we spent coding on day 3 that has now kind of helped with my confidence in building this website,,,,and i'm kind of excited??????? Let's not jinx it. I think I consciously took decisions with the elements and flexes with how much I can actually make, I originally wanted to add alot more stuff but I have to learn how to code, not how to decorate it...which is also the objective. I think you get the point, I'm just going around in circles trying to write what I think. I have decided my layout, it's the one with the static floral border and the newspaper inside it. My fonts are: HoldMoney for the Newspaper title, Lato for the headings and Source Sans Pro for the body text. Here's a link to my layout: https://www.figma.com/design/w940kHrJur0unxyKG5MXdd/WEBSITESSS?node-id=25-3&t=hY4tFuIHgHUDlCoa-1 I'm actually excited to start coding this..:P Okieeee thanksss byieeee

devNotes.content:
# Der aaye par durust aaye

# Day 6 Loved the heading for this 🤪 *the clock clocked me at this point* I think this always happens when I start learning something new, I always go off on a rough start, I couldn't figure out the prompts to give to these chatbots, alooootttt of misunderstandings and changing of accounts to log into claude accounts made me finally slow down and follow it step-by-step. A little less frustration, a little less laptop throwing was felt today...PROGRESS!!! oh and astro made it soooo easy! now that I know html and css 😎 (I'm sure this sarcasm is going to come around and bite me in the following week) but heyyyyy it makes me happy to say it so nevermind. But then I realised I had to feed in the vectors and concept and interactions, so it was cool. AI won't do it better than me. It was nice to look at sirs slide today and read "you can now say that we've never not coded" WEEEEEE 😜 Here's my hydration clock submission, that changes colour according to the time of day. https://hydrationclock.netlify.app/

devNotes.issueTitle: Day 7: A room of one's own
devNotes.content: # Make rooooooooooooooooooom *Whatever it is, there’s potential for a self-reflexive feedback loop: when you put energy into a website, in turn the website helps form your own identity.* -By Laurel I would like to start with this quote from Laurels' blog that Aditi read aloud in the class, which I later went back to, because it made sense. Today was all about "making room" for our identity, which we had maybe lost touch with due to j*bs. *sent shivers down my spine just thinking about it* What do we liiiiike? What are we passionate abouuuuttt? How do we want to express our own things in a space that we will be making for ourselves by ourselves? OoOoOoOh. I liked the time we got to sit and think about this, because as soon as I understood the entire task, there were a lot of ideas which only excited me. I instantly decided that my space is going to be pink. Why? Just. Now let's "make room" for my web. (see how I added the pun twice? 😎) These are the screenshots from the website that I liked: What I liked about this website? It's good. **I'M KIDDING** The best quality that stood out to me was that it looks extremely well thought of, personalized and quriky. There's a woman in one of the doors, who we just have to say hi to, because the full page has not been rendered yet. She's just standing there. Yep. Thats her. She's made a space for her laptop where there's pictures and a browser, AND the best thing was that she's even got the wifi, Bluetooth, and airplane mode icons and menu bar that lets us think that somethings actually changing. I have even mentioned this in the figma notes that this legit looks like her own room, maybe, maybe not. There are a few more websites that I mentioned in the file that caught my eye (primarily for the colour pink) also I like this mentioned website because it looks like a manga comic from webtoon. I used to be OBSESSED with that app during lockdown. I have more than three sections that I want to cover and maybe after tomorrows presentation, narrow it down further. The sections that I want to cover: Unhinged opinions on the content I consume or people I interact with. Random quizzes like buzzfeed. Daily movie screening (not that diverse, you'll see) sharing memes and stickers and quotes with one another a space where I want song/movie/book recommendations from people that visit my website A virtual library or an environment where people can sit and do their own work while something ambient and cozy goes around in the background and also incomplete or complete portfolio work that i'll keep adding in between my current work schedule. These work for me because there are some things that I do on a daily basis, and others are things that get my weird side out, without the fear of being judged. Yes I want to know what type of personality I have based on the icecream toppings I choose. Sign.Me.Up. These are the screenshots from my Figma Link. Here's a link to my fig-jam slide. https://www.figma.com/board/MgdLVdkMlnjh0ElScIuron/Anchita-s-space?node-id=0-1&t=pxSXoXBDov9cGZOT-1 Okieee thanks byieeee *welp, only 5 hours of sleep today, yippeeeee*

# Peeling the layers I honestly thought that I had my entire space figured out, but I got the chance to present first to put my ideas out and getting to know where there are spaces in my ideas. All of my classmates had really nice ideas and they had figured it out in a concise sharp way, with things they want or don't want. This what I want for my design. Clarity. I'm so sleepy that I cannot come up with a coherent sentence right now, so here's my schema. first one is for my blog, second one is for the quizzes and third is the virtual space. I didn't understand the meaning of "featured" here and I'm confused as to what should my schema look like if im adding a virtual space for people. is this accurate? Okie thanks byeee goodnight

# Slow paced day *OMG I get the title now!!!! It struck me after the fifth read* Todays concepts felt easier and lighter to grasp and work around, it was just a matter of terminologies and which title goes where. Uppercase vs lowercase, importing navigation and footer from their folders, step-by-step tutorials, the “ - - -“, markdowns, menu bars, etc. I think I accidentally made a mental checklist over here, was just trying to test my memory. The realisation I had today was that we’ve made so much progress over the past week and a half! (Little progress is also progress) Just yesterday I was having an existential crisis about the 9 tasks in that one assignment, and now here we are about to design AND CODE our own website! I’m so proud of all of us <3 I think the more I work on the components and layers for my own blog section, I’ll understand it better. No fuzzy concepts yet, excited to think about my design for the website tomorrow! *look who sat on my lap today guys🥺*

# No Bheja fry day I absolutely love the references, first the “layers” GIF and now Takeshi’s Castle😂😂 it’s amazing to read these notes after a long day of ideation and structuring. Today was a very good day, I got to make the wireframes on an iPad which I LOVE 😋 *love you apple* I was also kind of stuck on the design because I felt it might get repetitive and someone might’ve already used that idea, but I pushed past it and did what comes natural. Plus I had the tab so I felt very cool either ways. I was also working with the colour pink and a few things from my table today were pink as well, that might’ve contributed to my day being good. Working for a website that’ll just scream “ANCHITA” was a good change after a long time, I don’t think I have designed anything specific for me, and that’s bad I know. Tomorrow I’m aiming to get a better idea on my visuals and illustrative styles and be ready with the high fidelity homepage after. I already have an issue of setting insanely high goals for myself and then also curse myself for not being able to achieve them in the first go, so I will plan my week in a way that’ll challenge me and also give myself enough dopamine to continue till the end. Here’s my stylesheet submission that has the wireframe sketches as well. Okiieeee thanks byieeeeee

# Happy Happy I can’t believe we’re so close to making our own websites now…I didn’t even know what < div > was a while ago🥲 I set 10-12 issues on Github and it actually was like a dopamine hit when I was committing the files :P at one point I forgot about the issues and just made the home page dividing it into three sections. I loooveeeeddddd seeing my high fidelity come to life, and I’m sooooo excited to add the animations tomorrow!!! I finished adding all the elements (the images are placed as dummy, I’ll replace it with the original files) to my home page, I have placed them according to the high fidelity ( except the bottom most description box) and for tomorrow, I will finish that and add little animations, so I can start with the other sections in the second half. Seeeee my snakeee guysssss🥹🥹🥹🥹 The dopamine hit I was talking about Here’s a link to my “repo” 🤪 https://github.com/anchita101/Anchita-s-cornerr Okieee thanksss byiiieeeee

# Please excuse me for being late to this Dev-note I missed out on writing about the bestttttt working dayyyy everrrr, I was constantly showing everyone with the smallest of interaction/changes, and I got soooo exciteddddd, its all coming together and its such a cool mom moment to see my baby come to life. I got done with the two sections of the home page, and I had started with the blog section. The virtual space is still pending which kinda scares me because I might be subconsciously delaying it but heeeyyyy I'll do it anyyyywayssssss Okieeeee thanksss byieeeeee

devNotes.content:
# Didn't want to be late to this, but well anyway
Today, well yesterday was very stressful (I'm writing this on 11th August but for the 10th, so idk which word to use) 
Well I've felt worse but yesterday I was very demotivated, I wasn't sure if my website was going to finish within the timeframe but I still kept going because I liked what I was doing and that kept me going. Very Sandip Maheswari vibes buttttt itiswhatitisssssssssssss. I didn't feel like throwing my laptop or pull my hair or give up on life so that's a major win guysssss. I quite honestly was having a "I hate everything ive made so far" moments but I didn't share that with anyone because it made me sad. WELL NOT TODAY, HA! I finished MORE today because I forgot about those feelings. I FEEL SO PROUD. My baby is almost hereeeeeeeeeeeeeeee



OK thanks byyyyyieeeeeeeeeeee
